post.description: Login user and return JWT token.

Search for word definition and lemma using hybrid approach.

This endpoint uses a hybrid approach combining:
1. LLM (reduced prompt): Extracts lemma, related_words, and CEFR level
2. Free Dictionary API: Provides definition, POS, pronunciation, and forms

If the hybrid approach fails, falls back to full LLM.

Requires authentication to prevent API abuse.

Get token usage records for a specific article.

Returns all token usage records associated with the specified article.
Users can only access usage records for their own articles.

Args:
    article_id: Article ID to get usage for
    current_user: Authenticated user (required)

Returns:
    List of TokenUsageResponse objects sorted by created_at ascending
